pipeline_graph.derivation: aiops-intake.json + redaction-report.json -> semantic-chunk-plan.json -> pr-brief.json + chunk-payload-manifest.json + chunk-payloads/<id>.json -> [consumer: Router] -> chunk-responses/<id>.json -> chunk-results.json -> final-review.{json,md} -> review-quality-gate.json -> review-telemetry.json
pipeline_graph.consumption_note: parse-chunks consumes semantic-chunk-plan.json + chunk-responses/ (optional --intake is used only for the write-path guard); synthesize consumes chunk-results.json (+ optional plan/intake/redaction); quality-gate consumes final-review.json + chunk-results.json (+ optional intake/plan/redaction/checks, --critical-pr). pr-brief.json and chunk-payload-manifest.json are NOT consumed downstream of build-payloads.
pipeline_graph.authority: review-quality-gate.json is the only v1 decision artifact consumed by the publisher; final-review.md is the published text

obligations.proposition: Every file lacking an observable textual hunk is excluded from files_covered at plan level, for all tiers, with a tier-distinct reason code.
positive_controls: same PR where the non-must file has a textual hunk remains complete/passed
obligations.discriminator: paired input differing only in presence of the @@ hunk for the non-must file
obligations.closure_predicate: RED on base, GREEN on head, observed at the gate output; mutation of the generalized predicate back to must_review-only turns the focal test RED
obligations.open_decision: whether a non-must hunk-less file degrades the plan (status) or only moves to files_not_covered with an informational code — to be fixed in the V1-C1 task contract against #232's own text ('coverage: complete' semantics). Note: the second alternative requires changing _plan_status, because any files_not_covered currently returns degraded (semantic_chunker.py:741-742).

obligations.proposition: Tests whose subject is not hunk availability supply synthetic hunks; tests that pin the CM-CL1-01 outcome as expected are reconciled, not preserved by construction.
obligations.closure_predicate: no committed test asserts complete/passed for an input containing a hunk-less file without also asserting that file's non-covered state

positive_controls: list-shaped rules with a path-matching rule still inject contract context
obligations.closure_predicate: unparseable-shape input produces the distinct code; list-shaped input unchanged; golden payload fixtures unchanged for list-shaped input

obligations.proposition: A finding lacking a checkable negative consequence or whose cited subject is not present in the reviewed material leaves the confirmed-finding partition with a reason code, at all severities, through a channel that does not make the verdict stricter than the confirmed finding it replaces.

The only existing non-escalating channel, rejected_findings, is typed by the RejectedFindingReason Literal (schemas.py:62,341): a new reason code changes a v1 schema literal and falls under the golden-fixture constraint. Aboutness needs reviewed material as new parser input.

obligations.closure_predicate: each CM RED->GREEN observed on the confirmed/risk/rejected partition at synthesis and gate; no CM-CL3 case ends with a stricter verdict than before; PC-CL3-01 GREEN before and after; mutation removing each predicate turns its focal test RED
constraints: response-contract change requires positive justification against frozen v1 golden fixtures
obligations.open_decision: target channel: NormalizedRisk escalates to approve_with_required_followup; rejected_findings yields approve_with_minor_notes; v1 has no neutral observation channel

obligations.proposition: Every limitation code emitted by v1 is classified informational vs obligation-degrading, and every obligation-degrading code reaches the gate through a consumed artifact.

obligations.closure_predicate: classification table committed; one test per degrading class at gate level

positive_controls: P1 on a reviewed file stays passed/changes_requested

v1_v2_isolation.principle: ownership is decided by the import graph, not by the *_v2 filename suffix
v1_v2_isolation.v2_only_paths: diff of every v2-only surface must be empty for every v1 slice: app/agent_review/*_v2.py, schemas/agent-review/v2/**, scripts/*v2* (includes *-v2.py plus export-agent-review-v2-schemas.py, run-agent-review-v2-evals.py, verify-agent-review-v2-conformance.py), evals/agent_review_v2/**, tests/agent_review/*v2*; the set is re-derived on each slice's live base (suffix/name scan plus the import graph), not taken from this list
v1_v2_isolation.shared_module_rule: a v1 slice that edits any shared module must (a) run the full tests/agent_review suite (not the non-v2 subset), and (b) state in the PR why v2 behavior is unchanged across the whole transitive reach, not only the direct importers; an intended or unexplained v2 behavior change is STOP_UNEXPECTED_V2_COUPLING
v1_v2_isolation.not_shared_on_derivation_subject: semantic_chunker.py and payload_cost_model.py are not imported by v2 (asserted by tests/agent_review/test_semantic_chunker_225_red.py:312); recompute the import graph on each slice's live base
v1_v2_isolation.derivation: AST scan of absolute, 'from app.agent_review import X' and relative imports over app/**, scripts/** and evals/** at ab92e89f (shared set {redaction, schemas, versioning} verified complete, including transitive closure); recompute on each slice's live base
v1_v2_isolation.transitive_reach: contracts_v2 imports redaction, and redaction imports schemas; versioning imports schemas and contracts_v2. A change to redaction.py or schemas.py therefore reaches essentially the whole v2 lane transitively (via contracts_v2), and a change to versioning.py reaches the v2 parser/synthesis/readiness/transport/consumer chain and scripts/aiops-review-quality-gate-v2.py. The direct-importer lists above are not the blast radius.

slice_gates.golden_fixtures: any change to frozen v1 golden fixtures requires positive, reasoned justification in the PR (app/agent_review/AGENTS.md#Compatibility)
